title: Expanding AI Driven EV accessibility across key economic hubs with full 3S/4S integration, integrated high-speed charging infrastructure, and top-tier dealer partnerships.
summary: Discover how XPENG Malaysia is expanding to 10 new 3S/4S showrooms and service centres by end-2026, with charging at selected sites and certified EV teams.
body_markdown:
# ***Expanding*** ***AI*** ***Driven EV*** ***accessibility*** ***across key economic hubs with full 3S/4S integration, integrated high-speed charging infrastructure, and top-tier dealer partnerships.***


**KUALA LUMPUR, 21 September 2026** — XPENG Malaysia today announced a major expansion of its nationwide retail and aftersales footprint, confirming **10 new strategic 3S/4S showroom locations targeted for deployment across Malaysia by the end of 2026** . This rapid network development reinforces XPENG’s long-term commitment to establishing a comprehensive, high-touch Smart EV ownership ecosystem for Malaysian customers.


XPENG Malaysia’s retail network is engineered around four core operational pillars designed to set a new standard for premium electric mobility ownership:


**1. Full 3S/4S Integration for Total Ownership Peace of Mind**


Every location in the new 10-showroom network is established as a **full 3S (Sales, Service & Spare Parts)** **or 4S (Sales, Service, Spare Parts, Body & Paint Services) facility** . By embedding certified aftersales infrastructure, specialized diagnostic tools, and dedicated parts inventory directly into each site, XPENG ensures owners receive immediate, uncompromised long-term care from day one.


**2. Strategic Coverage Across All Major Cities & High-Growth Hubs**


The 10 new facilities are strategically positioned across Malaysia’s primary metropolitan corridors and high-density economic zones. This nationwide blanket ensures that prospective buyers and existing owners across major urban areas enjoy convenient, direct access to test drives, advisory services, and routine maintenance.


**3. Dedicated High-Speed Charging** **Infrastructure** **& Tech Experience Hubs**


To address real-world ownership needs, selected XPENG centers will feature integrated high-speed EV charging facilities, giving drivers convenient access to rapid charging within the brand's network. Furthermore, each facility will double as an interactive experience center where customers can explore XPENG's latest Physical AI, smart cockpit interfaces, and automated driving capabilities firsthand.


**4. Enterprise Partnerships with Seasoned Automotive Groups**


XPENG Malaysia is partnering exclusively with established, high-performing automotive dealer groups. Each facility will feature dedicated, EV-certified technicians and advisory teams specialized in XPENG’s high-voltage vehicle architecture, connected operating software, and proprietary diagnostic platforms.


**Executive Commentary**


*"Our expansion strategy is about far more than increasing store counts—it is about establishing an absolute benchmark for customer confidence and ownership convenience in Malaysia's EV landscape,"* said **Sam Chu, Regional General Manager of XPENG South East Asia** .


*"By building out full-service 3S/4S centers equipped with integrated charging support and backed by Malaysia's premier automotive dealer groups, we are ensuring complete peace of mind at every step of the ownership journey. As our smart AI vehicle lineup continues to grow, this expanded network guarantees that every XPENG owner receives an exceptional, high-touch experience wherever they are."*


**Driving the Next Phase of** **AI** **Driven Mobility in Malaysia**


This network expansion aligns with XPENG’s momentum in the region as it continues to grow its intelligent EV portfolio and local footprint. By combining advanced 800V fast-charging architecture, cutting-edge Physical AI capabilities, and comprehensive 3S/4S infrastructure, XPENG Malaysia is positioned to drive the next era of premium electric mobility across the nation.


**About XPENG Malaysia**


XPENG is a leading global Physical AI company that designs, develops, manufactures, and markets intelligent mobility solutions. Dedicated to bringing artificial intelligence (AI) into physical mobility, XPENG leverages in-house advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), intelligent operating software, and next-generation electric powertrains to redefine the modern driving experience.
